[[File:Caemlynmap.png|thumb|Map of Caemlyn depicting Low Caemlyn]]
'''Low Caemlyn''' is the outermost district of [[Caemlyn]], capital of the kingdom of [[Andor]]. It is situated outside of the outer city walls surrounding the [[New City]] and consists mainly of farmer communities having grown together into part of the city over the centuries. 

==[[Fall of Caemlyn]]==
Low Caemlyn burned together with the rest of the city during the initial hours of the [[Last Battle]].{{ref/book|14|p}}
